Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged __within a predetermined time period__, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor __that is different from the first alarm__.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

Claim 3 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

Claim 4 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

Claim 6 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

Claim 7 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered __and an escalation status of the alarm__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __including the escalation status__.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

Claim 20 (Previously presented): The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices.
